summary: California Water Service Group filed an 8-K announcing a routine quarterly dividend declaration of $0.3350 per share, payable August 21, 2026, to holders of record August 10, 2026. This is the 326th consecutive quarterly dividend, a normal capital-return event for a utility. No special-situation elements such as M&A, restructuring, or strategic review are present. The filing is purely informational under Item 8.01. No deal terms apply. Action is routine and does not constitute a special situation. What to watch: none; continue monitoring standard dividend declarations.
